name: alp-monorepo
description: Autonomous Lifecycle Protocol (ALP) - The universal protocol for autonomous software engineering

scripts.test: npm run build --workspace @autonomous-lifecycle-protocol-alp/parser --workspace @autonomous-lifecycle-protocol-alp/sdk --workspace @autonomous-lifecycle-protocol-alp/cli --workspace @autonomous-lifecycle-protocol-alp/platform --workspace @autonomous-lifecycle-protocol-alp/mcp-server --workspace sham --workspace alp-vscode && vitest run && cd playground && npx vitest run && cd ../commercial/alp-server && npx vitest run
